name: Vespid Dynamics Swarm Canister SC-2 'Hornets'
description: A launchable canister containing twelve autonomous micro-drones, each roughly the size of a human thumb, equipped with a shaped-charge warhead capable of defeating light armor. Once deployed, the swarm uses collective optical tracking to identify and converge on a designated target type — personnel, vehicles, or electronics. The drones communicate via ultrasonic chirps that give the swarm its characteristic insectoid sound. Individual drones are easily destroyed, but the swarm's distributed targeting means eliminating all twelve before detonation is statistically improbable.
specifications:
drone count: 12 per canister
warhead: 2g shaped copper charge per drone
swarm radius: 40 meter engagement envelope
flight time: 90 seconds per drone
target acquisition: Collective optical + ultrasonic coordination
weight: 1.8 kg per canister
launch method: Pneumatic tube launcher or hand-thrown
story_hooks: A swarm canister detonated in a crowded market — but the drones only targeted people with a specific model of cranial implant, suggesting the targeting firmware has been modified.
Vespid's insurance division is quietly settling claims from a friendly-fire incident where an SC-2 swarm misidentified allied security forces as hostiles.

physical_description.visual_profile: A cylindrical pod roughly the size of a large energy drink can, with a tapered nose cone and segmented body. The design suggests contained pressure and carefully organized interior space. Its sleek profile is broken by asymmetrical venting ports and a raised launch collar at the base.
physical_description.dimensions: Height: 18 cm, Diameter: 6.5 cm, Launch collar diameter: 7.2 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light and balanced — feels like holding a sealed pressure vessel rather than a weapon. Slightly bottom-heavy due to propellant charge distribution.
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer composite (impact-resistant casing) with internal titanium launch collar and copper-lined shaped-charge inserts
physical_description.finish: Matte tactical black exterior with honeycomb texture pattern across the body (functional cooling/grip enhancement). Brushed titanium launch collar with faint anodized blue highlights.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black primary body with metallic titanium base ring. Accent stripe of warning yellow running spirally down the canister. Small Vespid Dynamics gold-foil logo at the 12 o'clock position.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer with subtle hexagonal surface pattern (biomimetic honeycomb). Base collar is knurled titanium — cool to touch, high-grip friction.
distinctive_features: Six vent ports arranged radially around the upper third (micro-drone exit points)
Etched numeric identifier and batch code in small white letters (SC-2-447291-GLMZ)
Transparent micro-window at nose cone showing faint metallic glint of packed drones inside
Pressure relief valve cap (red anodized) at the tip
Faint scratches and scuff marks indicating field use or transport handling
Ultrasonic emitter grid visible as fine perforations beneath the vent ports
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS embossed in small gold foil at the upper body. Manufacturing date stamp (2225-Q3) stamped in white on the side. Serial microplate below the logo.
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually clean and well-maintained (explosive ordinance), though transport containers show typical scuff wear. Internal mechanisms are never visible under normal conditions.
